checked.test: a change the server refuses after the timeout > an Undo refused before its own timeout, after the recording was refused, does not say the Undo failed
checked.reason: Confirmed: 'Unable to undo' appears nowhere in lib/, so that assertion can never fail. The fix the auditor proposed points at the wrong text, though. This test refuses the delete before its timeout, so settle throws a FirebaseException and undoLog (lib/writes/log_one.dart:180-186) takes the catch branch. That branch shows 'Could not undo. <error>' unless rejected.createRefused(activityID) is true. 'Not deleted' is only the banner label for a refusal that arrives after the timeout, so it does not cover this branch. If createRefused were broken, 'Not deleted' would still not appear and the test would stay green. The change: replace the line with expect(find.textContaining('Could not undo'), findsNothing). That is the assertion that carries the test's title.
